SYMPTOM: Assumed macOS→Windows cross-compilation was impossible for Tauri/whisper-rs. Actually partially works.

FIX ATTEMPTED: `cargo install cargo-xwin`, then `cargo xwin build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`. Downloads Windows SDK/CRT headers automatically.

PROGRESS: Gets past ring (crypto crate with C code), gets past llvm-lib requirement. Currently stops at opusic-sys (Opus codec) during CMake step — needs Ninja build system.

NEXT STEP: `brew install ninja` should unblock opusic-sys. Unknown what breaks after that (whisper-rs CMake with Vulkan headers is the likely next wall).

CAVEATS:
- Tauri docs say cross-compilation unsupported — this is about the full .exe bundle with WebView2. cargo check/build for the Rust code itself works further than expected.
- Even if Rust compiles, Tauri bundler (NSIS installer, WebView2 bootstrapper) still needs Windows.
- cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc is useful for validating cfg blocks without native deps.

PREVENT: Don't give up on cross-compilation without trying cargo-xwin first. It's not all-or-nothing.
